purpose: Teach: 可動/一団/電通/テコ/使節/敷設/全貌/国内線

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、可動式の工場を設計された
lines.en: When Dad founded the company, he designed the factory to be modular.
lines.style: Gentle, unhurried recollection. Soft opening. Voice carries the weight of memory without strain. Measured cadence — honoring the moment. Brief pause after the statement, as if letting it settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員を一団としてまとめられた
lines.en: Yes. He had a way of bringing the staff together as one cohesive unit.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation, tender. Speaks with measured respect — not performing, remembering. Slight warmth in the voice when naming his father's gift. Steady, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、電通の方とも親交がおありだった
lines.en: He had connections with people at Dentsu, you know.
lines.style: Soft, almost musing quality. Voice drifts slightly, catching on the memory. Not seeking confirmation — observing something only he fully grasps. Trailing intonation that says there's more to the story.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはテコ入れのタイミングを的確に見極めた
lines.en: Yes. He had an uncanny sense for when to make the crucial move — when the timing was exactly right.
lines.style: Calm, thoughtful cadence. Voice deepens slightly with recognition of his father's acumen. Each phrase lands with quiet certainty. No rush — the respect is in the pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、海外使節団を率いられた
lines.en: He led delegations overseas. A lot of them.
lines.style: Voice softens with a kind of awe. Opens gently on the first phrase. Slight exhale before the second statement — there's something almost overwhelming about cataloging these achievements. Tender, not boastful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは工場のラインを敷設する陣頭指揮もされた
lines.en: Yes. He personally oversaw the installation of every factory line across the country.
lines.style: Steady, deliberate. Voice carries weight — commanding without volume. Respect in every word. Slight emphasis on 'personally' — acknowledging the magnitude of his father's presence and hands-on leadership.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界の全貌を見渡されてた
lines.en: He saw the entire industry. The whole landscape of it.
lines.style: Voice opens with quiet awe. Slight breathiness — touched by the scope of what his father held in view. Slower pace. The trailing statement lands softly, as if trying to capture something almost beyond words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは国内線で全国を駆け回られた
lines.en: Yes. He traveled everywhere by domestic flight. Across the whole country, constantly.
lines.style: Slow, dignified cadence. Voice carries quiet pride mixed with gentle sorrow — a life well-lived, but always in motion. Soft close, as if settling into the finality of that legacy. Warm but contemplative.
